label: D1 after a reward, agent about to choose a2, late in the episode
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (99.9% of mass) and only when the reward input is 1 (D1 & in_rew==1: recall 0.98, mass recall 0.999, precision 0.13). It never fires at D2, and essentially never at GO, on unrewarded D1 steps, or when the agent is about to choose a1. Within rewarded D1 steps it needs (a) an upcoming a2 choice, which is the agent own computed choice (moderately negative policy logit -4.4..-1.5 holds 92% of mass); adding it raises precision to 0.24 at recall 0.95. The observed proxy prev_action==2 gives F1 0.39 / 0.64 with the late-episode term, a bit below the action version, so I recorded the action version. (b) Late episode: rate climbs steeply after ep_trial ~70 (90-99: 11% of steps, 47% of mass) and tracks low value-head output; it never fires when value > 7.73. Never fires in the first 3 trials. Activation tends to grow over consecutive rewarded D1 steps in a window, and the strongest cases come late in an episode while the agent keeps choosing a2 with S2 good, with rare-rewarded trials in the history. The ep_trial cutoff is a stand-in for a graded drift (low value / time in episode). That leaves about 30% false positives and 26% missed mass, so this is only partially explained.
